adjudication.rationale: Diff shows `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` was changed to an array and team collective flows can append multiple destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`), but when persisting the booking it only connects the first element: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (handleNewBooking.ts). Across modules, the implementation repeatedly destructures `[mainHostDestinationCalendar] = ...` and treats index 0 as the canonical calendar, so the “first element is main host” convention is indeed implicit and leaking. This is a scope/architecture concern (lossy persistence vs new array model) visible in the diff, though it’s not provably a runtime defect without knowing whether booking is intended to store only the organizer’s destination calendar while references track the rest.
